title: 第四十三章 皇室供奉堂第四十二章 回归新身份
lines: 第四十三章皇室供奉堂
“末将吴新泰，参见监军大人。”
【玄甲营】的营门之前，王平打量着眼前披坚执锐的武将，而后目光一转，看向了眼前的巍峨军营。
好生厉害。
在王平看来，眼前武将的实力并不强，充其量也就是个内劲武师，然而他的身上却有一股莫名的势。
若是沉下心去听，就能听到这股势来自他身后的军营，五百多人的呼吸形同一体，如风雷一般沉寂其中，仿佛这并非军营，而是一头匍匐在大地上的荒古巨兽，最后甚至在他眼中形成了幻视。
‘和县衙的捕快一样.....不，更强！’
毕竟县衙捕快也只有百余位，而眼下这座军营起码翻了五倍，形成的神意和军威自然也要远胜前者。
想到这里，王平很快做出了判断。
‘此人也比徐秉正更强。’
‘有这五百人的军营加持，哪怕他只有内劲武师的修为，真打起来，杀徐秉正不会比杀鸡困难多少。’
这是好事。
毕竟自己手里就握着天子御赐的铜制兵符，还有圣旨在，【玄甲营】的实力越强，对他其实越有利。
如此看来，这做官其实也不是没有可取之处嘛。
“无须多礼。”
王平微微一笑，伸手将吴新泰扶了起来：“本官虽身负重任，却也是初来乍到，之后还得仰仗将军。”
“哪里哪里....”
吴新泰闻言目光微亮，看出了王平言语中的好意，语气顿时热烈了几分，彼此气氛也迅速融洽起来。
话虽如此，吴新泰心中却也忍不住嘀咕：
‘这位执金缇骑.....好像不是很强啊。’
‘内劲武师，小周天功体？怎么连封号武师都不是，难道是哪家的公子哥趁此机会特地过来镀金的？’
【玄甲营】外，一处小山坡上。
就在王平走进【玄甲营】的同时，他和吴新泰的言行都被站在此地，俯瞰营帐的两道身影尽收眼底。
两人的容貌打扮各有不同，一人生得猿臂蜂腰，尖嘴猴腮，手中提着一根盘龙棍，乍看之下仿佛酒店客栈里的小厮，另一人则是眼眸细长，微笑时尖牙毕露，什么都不用做就给人一种狠厉感。
尖嘴猴腮的男人率先开口道：“执金缇骑，用这个身份作为用来投石问路的石子，应该已经不小了。”
说完，他突然轻笑一声：
“执金缇骑，天子禁卫。”
“你说，那小子该不会真以为陛下会将如此重任全部交托在他一个甚至都还没有封号的武师手里吧？”
“说不准，也由不得他。”
狠厉男子淡淡道：“无论他是否发觉真相，该做的还是得做，否则就是欺君抗命，左右也无甚区别。”
“倒也是。”
尖嘴猴腮的男子神色微凝：“无论如何，这龙兴县的水很深，否则国子监和陛下也不会投来视线了。”
“当然深了。”
狠厉男子沉声道：“我事前调查过，此地乃是前朝太祖的起家之地，因此才得到了【龙兴】的名字。”

Chapter 43: Royal Enshrinement Hall
"The last general Wu Xintai, please see the Lord Supervisor of the Army."
In front of the camp gate of [Xuanjia Camp], Wang Ping looked at the strong and sharp generals in front of him, then turned his eyes and looked at the majestic military camp in front of him.
So awesome.
In Wang Ping's opinion, the military commander in front of him was not very strong, at best he was just an internal martial artist. However, there was an inexplicable power about him.
If he calmed down and listened, he could hear that this force came from the military camp behind him. The breathing of more than 500 people was unified, as silent as wind and thunder, as if this was not a military camp, but an ancient giant beast crawling on the ground. In the end, it even formed a hallucination in his eyes.
'Same as the county government's police officers... no, stronger! ’
After all, there are only a hundred or so county police officers, and now the military camp has grown at least five times in size, so the divine will and military power formed are naturally far superior to the former.
Thinking of this, Wang Ping quickly made a judgment.
‘This person is also stronger than Xu Bingzheng. ’
'With the blessing of these five hundred people from the military camp, even if he only has the cultivation level of a Neijing martial artist, in a real fight, killing Xu Bingzheng will not be much more difficult than killing a chicken. ’
This is a good thing.
After all, he holds in his hand the copper talisman and the holy object given by the emperor. The stronger the [Xuanjia Camp] is, the more beneficial it is to him.
From this point of view, being an official is not without its merits.
"No need to be polite."
Wang Ping smiled slightly and stretched out his hand to help Wu Xintai up: "Although I have a heavy responsibility, I am still here for the first time. I will have to rely on the general in the future."
"Where, where..."
Wu Xintai's eyes brightened when he heard this, and he saw the good intentions in Wang Ping's words. His tone suddenly became more enthusiastic, and the atmosphere between them quickly became harmonious.
Even so, Wu Xintai couldn't help but mutter in his heart:
‘This gold-wielding Tiqi... doesn’t seem to be very strong. ’
‘Nei Jin martial artist, Xiao Zhou Tian Kung Fu Body? Why is he not even a titled martial artist? Could it be that some young master took this opportunity to come here to do the gold plating? ’
.............
Outside [Xuanjia Camp], on a hillside.
Just as Wang Ping walked into [Xuanjia Camp], the words and deeds of him and Wu Xintai were reflected in the two figures standing here, overlooking the camp.
The appearance and dress of the two people are different. One of them has an ape-like body, a sharp mouth and monkey cheeks, and holds a dragon stick in his hand. At first glance, he looks like a boy in a hotel. The other has slender eyes and exposed fangs when he smiles. He gives people a fierce feeling without doing anything.
"....How?"
The man with a sharp mouth and monkey cheeks was the first to speak: "It is not a small thing to use this status as a gold cavalry to throw stones to ask for directions."
After saying that, he suddenly chuckled:
"Holding a golden cavalry, the emperor's imperial guard."
"Tell me, does that kid really think that His Majesty would entrust such an important task to him, a martial artist who has not even been titled yet?"
"I can't say for sure, and it's not up to him."
The stern man said calmly: "No matter whether he discovers the truth or not, he still has to do what he has to do, otherwise he will be bullying the emperor and disobeying his orders, and there will be no difference between the left and the right."
"That's true."
The man with a sharp mouth and monkey cheeks looked slightly condensed: "In any case, the water in Longxing County is very deep, otherwise the Imperial College and His Majesty would not pay attention."
"Of course it's deep."
The stern man said in a deep voice: "I have investigated beforehand and found that this place was the place where the ancestor of the previous dynasty started, so it got the name [Longxing]."
